What the scope can include

A condition survey decides what should be retained, repaired or replaced.

Property-wide coordinationOne surveyed scope connects common areas, tenant zones, services and use-conversion work.
01Tenant improvement worksAdapt existing units for new occupants, layouts, finishes and technical needs.
02Common-area upgradesRefresh lobbies, corridors, washrooms and shared circulation.
03Business space remodelingReplan active commercial interiors around new operations or capacity.
04Use conversionCoordinate the interior changes needed when a property takes on a new purpose.
05Services upgradesImprove electrical, lighting, plumbing, HVAC and data systems.
06Exterior touchpointsCoordinate entrances, frontage, signage zones and arrival areas where included.

A process shaped for commercial renovation

Survey, scope, BOQ and phasing are agreed before disruptive work starts.

01

Property survey

Audit condition, access, active tenants and building services.

02

Stakeholder scope

Separate landlord, tenant and common-area responsibilities.

03

Phasing strategy

Plan zone closures, temporary routes and service shutdowns.

04

BOQ and programme

Issue itemized quantities, materials, milestones and sequencing.

05

Coordinated delivery

Execute, inspect and hand over one controlled area at a time.
